composition.rule: EACH F13 IDENTITY MUTATES EXACTLY TWO DISTINCT RESOLVED FRONTIERS TO NON_BASELINE VALUES. ALL OTHER FRONTIERS REMAIN AT CORE BASELINE. NO SINGLE_FRONTIER OR TRIPLE_PLUS INTERACTION IS GENERATED IN F13.

shock_event.definition: Construct causal shock candidate bar_t from selected shock_measure/ATR_period/ATR_smoothing mutations if present, otherwise core HIGH_LOW_RANGE_OVER_ATR/ATR14/SMA_TR; then apply frozen CURRENT or LAGGED ATR reference timing and frozen threshold grid.

same_shock_bar_filters.definition: Apply directional persistence plus any F05 close-location and F06 wick mutation on original shock bar_t.

pre_shock_contexts.definition: F08 volatility, F09 spread and F10 tick-intensity contexts are evaluated with their frozen bindings at shock bar_t using only their defined pre-shock information; qualifying context is attached to that shock event even if later confirmation shifts final signal timestamp.

post_shock_confirmation.definition: If F07 is active, apply its exact frozen confirmation/window semantics to each qualifying shock event and map a surviving event to the F07 confirmation signal bar; otherwise final signal bar equals shock bar_t.

day_of_week.definition: If F12_DOW is active, apply its frozen Darwinex server-calendar weekday formula to the FINAL SIGNAL BAR. Thus with F07 the confirmation signal bar is day-filtered; without F07 the shock bar is day-filtered.

refractory.definition: If F11 is active, apply its frozen per-configuration/per-side refractory operator AFTER the fully composed causal signal mask and BEFORE trade selection/execution, measured in final signal-timeframe bar indices. This prospectively composes the F11 rule 'applies after raw causal signal mask' with F13 and does not rewrite F11 historical results.

execution.definition: Entry is first executable quote strictly after final causal signal close; BUY Ask in/Bid out, SELL Bid in/Ask out; ASK>Bid executable; SL first; first actually available gap price; one active position per asset; same timestamp re-entry forbidden.

management.atr_evaluation: If F07 active, use the confirmation signal bar as frozen by F07; otherwise use final shock signal bar. No management parameter search in F13.
